name: 65251 · Fulton, MO
findings: ZIP 65251 (Fulton) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65251 (Fulton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 65251 (Fulton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
